highlights:

# Nebius raises GPU prices again October 1; H100 to $4.50, B300 to $9.50

Nebius lists higher on demand GPU prices effective October 1, 2026. H100 rises from $3.85 to $4.50 per GPU hour. H200 rises from $4.50 to $5.40, B200 from $7.15 to $8.50, and B300 from $7.85 to $9.50. This round is 17% to 21%. It is reported to be the second increase since May. [1] [2]

Published September 28, 2026 Announced, effective October 1, 2026

## Disclosed terms

HGX H100, per GPU hour

$3.85 now, $4.50 from October 1 [1]

HGX H200, per GPU hour

$4.50 now, $5.40 from October 1 [1]

HGX B200, per GPU hour

$7.15 now, $8.50 from October 1 [1]

HGX B300, per GPU hour

$7.85 now, $9.50 from October 1 [1]

...

### What changed

Nebius's pricing page now shows two on demand columns: today's rate and a rate effective October 1, 2026. H100 rises 17%, H200 20%, B200 19% and B300 21%. [1]

Spot rates still start at $0.79 for H100 and H200 and $0.99 for B200 and B300. RTX PRO 6000 stays at $1.80. CPU only instances also rise. Nebius still advertises commitment discounts of up to 35% off on demand for multi month cluster reservations. [1]

Nebius's pricing page does not give a reason for the change.

### The second increase this year

This is not the first increase. The Motley Fool reports that in early May, Nebius's pricing page showed H100 at $2.95 per hour and B300 at $6.10. [2] Our own catalog recorded H100 at $3.85 on September 18 and B300 at $7.85 on September 24.

If the May figures are right, the October rates are about 53% higher for H100 and 56% higher for B300 than five months earlier. [2] The trend matters more than any single rate. A budget built on spring pricing may already be out of date.

### How the new rates compare

We compared the new rates with published on demand rates in our provider catalog, checked September 18 to 28.

H100: At $4.50, Nebius moves above Runpod ($3.49), Crusoe ($3.90) and Lambda ($4.29). It stays below CoreWeave's 8 GPU instance, about $6.16 per GPU.

H200: At $5.40, Nebius moves above Runpod ($4.59) and Verda ($4.55). It stays below Together AI ($5.99) and CoreWeave (about $6.31 per GPU).

B200: At $8.50, Nebius moves well above Lambda ($6.69) and Runpod ($6.79). CoreWeave's 8 GPU instance works out to about $8.60 per GPU.

B300: At $9.50, Nebius moves above Verda ($8.20) and Scaleway ($7.50). Together AI lists $9.99.

Configurations differ. vCPUs, memory, storage, networking and minimum allocation all vary. A lower hourly rate is not a lower project cost on its own.

results.title: What an hour of NVIDIA's B300 actually costs — and why the price is moving up. | Paul Goll
results.author: Paul Goll
highlights:
What an hour of NVIDIA's B300 actually costs — and why the price is moving up.

I priced the Blackwell Ultra B300 across live cloud listings and public trackers (September 2026):

On-demand, per GPU-hour:
- RunPod Community — $6.94
- Verda (Finland) — $7.50, spot $3.75
- Nebius — $7.85, spot $4.30
- RunPod Secure — $7.89
- 8-GPU nodes — $4.50–7.50 per GPU

Medians from third-party trackers: cloud-gpus.com $8.71 on-demand / $3.75 spot / $7.24 reserved; gputable.dev's cheapest listing $6.60; gambit.zone $7.94 (7 quotes).

Two facts I keep coming back to:

1. The on-demand price rose from roughly $4.5 to $9.16 an hour in about six months — 83% — and it is a supply number, not a demand number.
2. The card is the cheap part. A DGX B300 (8 GPUs) lists near $350k; a full GB300 NVL72 rack (72 B300s, 37 TB fast memory) is estimated at $3–6.5M.

results.title: Verda explained: GPU cloud, serverless and pricing
results.author: Sequenced desk
highlights:
Verda brings several ways of running AI workloads into one GPU cloud: individual instances, multi-node clusters and serverless containers. The company previously operated as DataCrunch. Its current offer is most useful when a team needs to move between experimentation, training and deployment without pretending those workloads have identical storage, latency or billing requirements.

...

## 01 / Product One company identity, several execution models

Verda’s rebrand announcement describes the transition from DataCrunch to Verda as a change of name with the same company, team and platform. The announcement set the website transition for November 2025. Older DataCrunch references therefore belong to this company history rather than a separate competing provider.

...

## 04 / Pricing The same GPU name can carry a different service price

The public pricing page separates GPU instances from serverless configurations. The entries below are USD figures consulted on 23 September 2026. CPU, memory and deployment arrangements differ between services, so the H100 rows are not interchangeable quotations for an identical bundle.

| Service | Published rate or basis | Qualification |
| --- | --- | --- |
| H100 GPU instance | $3.38 per hour | On-demand instance configuration listed on the page. |
| H100 serverless container | $3.72 per hour | Separate serverless configuration; per-replica ten-minute billing intervals. |
| Instant Clusters | On-demand per GPU-hour; reserved arrangements by quote | Confirm node topology, term and available capacity. |
| Shared filesystem | $0.20 per GiB per month shown | Confirm metered units in the quote; do not infer a converted storage total. |

Published Verda pricing and serverless billing, consulted 23 September 2026. Capacity and configuration remain subject to the current offer.

results.title: [新聞] AI折舊論遭打臉？Nebius傳再漲價、連H100也漲租- 看板 Stock - Mo PTT 鄉公所
highlights:
時間 2026/09/19 09:56

 文章標題 請使用 原新聞標題 勿刪減或自創標題，違者4-1處分 原文標題： 請勿刪減或自創標題，違者4-1處分，此行請刪除 AI折舊論遭打臉？Nebius傳再漲價、連H100也漲租 原文連結： 網址超過一行，請用縮網址，連結不能點擊者板規 1-2-2 處分。 https://tinyurl.com/2c7cqf5u 發布時間： 請勿張貼超過3天新聞 2026/09/18 08:34 記者署名： 郭妍希 原文內容： 市場傳出，荷蘭AI基礎建設供應商Nebius Group近期通知客戶，將調高一系列AI晶片的隨需租用價格(on-demand rental prices)， 其中多款輝達(Nvidia Corp.)繪圖處理器(GPU)的租金將上漲約20%。 綜合Barron`s、路透社等外電報導，Futurum Equities首席市場策略師Shay Boloor 17日透過社交平台X指出，Nebius剛剛宣布，自10月1日起調高隨需GPU租用價格，輝達旗下 H100、H200、B200與B300的費率均上漲約20%。 其中，B300漲幅最大，每GPU小時租金將從7.85美元調高至9.50美元。與此同時，Nebius也持續擴大在歐洲與美國的GPU供應量。 另外，根據路透消息，Nebius已是三個月來第二度漲價，傳出的部分漲價細節如下： ‧ 部分輝達GPU的租用費率將調漲17%至21%。 ‧ 部分採用超微(AMD)與英特爾(Intel)中央處理器(CPU)的隨需運算服務，以及記憶體服務價格也將調高。 ‧ Nebius表示，部分純CPU運算執行個體的價格將上漲25%，部分記憶體服務價格則將調高約41%。 ‧ Nebius指出，若客戶預訂大規模運算叢集、租期達數個月，可享有長期承諾折扣。 Nebius此次漲價前，旗下AI雲端業務剛經歷一季快速成長，期間簽下4份客戶合約，每份合約平均金額超過10億美元。Nebius等新型雲端業者(neocloud)主要出租AI模型所需的高效能晶片與資料中心基礎設施。 這波漲價另一個值得注意之處，是Nebius連H100晶片的租用價格也一併調高。H100早在2022年就已推出。 包括電影《大賣空》本尊麥可貝瑞(Michael Burry)在內的AI懷疑論者，過去提出的一項主要論點是，雲端運算公司採用6年折舊年限，因此高估了向輝達採購晶片的長期價值。所謂折舊年限，是將資產成本分攤至預估使用年限的期間；若這項質疑成立，就意味著晶片買家一直系統性低估每年的折舊費用。 如今Nebius有信心調高推出已約4年的晶片租用價格，顯示至少就目前而言，先前的這項質疑可能並不成立。 Nebius 17日聞訊勁揚4.12%、收217.99美元。 其他新型雲端商也同步走強。IREN、TeraWulf、Applied Digital 17日分別勁揚2.02%、7.02%、8.16%。 心得/評論： ※必須填寫滿30正體中文字，心得過短或濫竽充數將以板規 1-2-3 處分 從這個新聞來看 算力過剩論~AI要採煞車的狀況減弱了 看起來現在算力還在嚴重不足 所以才會算力價格繼續漲價
